title: Petualangan Bangun Ruang: Benteng & Kota Lama
type: Offline HTML/CSS/JavaScript educational RPG mini game
subject: Matematika kelas VIII - Bangun Ruang bernuansa etnomatematika
theme: Benteng Fort Willem I dan Kota Lama Semarang
main_features: 3 goa besar sebagai pintu masuk mini game
Karakter manusia CSS dengan animasi jalan halus
Joystick bulat kiri bawah seperti game RPG mobile
Kontrol keyboard WASD dan tombol panah
Tombol Home untuk pulang ke tampilan awal
Leaderboard di halaman awal kanan form nama/kelas
Penyimpanan banyak user memakai localStorage browser
Tombol hapus user per baris leaderboard dan hapus semua data
Progres siswa dilanjutkan otomatis jika nama dan kelas sama
Timer 2 menit per goa/mini game, otomatis selesai saat waktu habis
Sound effect masuk goa yang sama untuk goa 1, 2, dan 3
Musik dalam Goa 1, Goa 2, dan Goa 3 berbeda
Efek suara jawaban benar, jawaban salah, soal ke-5, dan finish semua goa
Tombol mute/unmute musik pada HUD map

mini_games.title: Game 1: Tebak Jaring-Jaring
mini_games.focus: Memilih jaring-jaring prisma, limas, kerucut, tabung, dan konsep bola

mini_games.title: Game 2: Tebak Bangun dari Ciri-Ciri
mini_games.focus: Mengenali bangun ruang dari sifat dan unsur-unsurnya

mini_games.title: Game 3: Hitung Volume dan Luas
mini_games.focus: Menghitung luas permukaan dan volume objek geometri kontekstual

controls.keyboard: WASD or arrow keys on the map only
controls.enter_cave: ENTER, E, or click Masuk Game

latest_updates: Keyboard movement no longer blocks typing W/A/S/D in forms.
Movement input is active only while the map screen is open.
Player character replaced with smooth CSS walking avatar without sprite ghost artifacts.
Home button remains available on the map and quiz screens.
Added right-side leaderboard panel on the start screen.
Added per-student saved progress using browser localStorage.
Added delete button for individual leaderboard users.
Added clear all leaderboard and progress button.
Added Vercel API routes in /api for MongoDB Atlas leaderboard.
Added audio assets in assets/audio/. Sound files can be replaced with same filenames.
Changed countdown behavior: each cave/mini game now has a 2-minute timer, not a 2-second start delay.
When time is up, the mini game automatically finishes and the current score is saved/calculated.

storage.randomization: Question order and answer options are shuffled every mini game session

timer.score_behavior: Current mini-game score is calculated and saved when time is up.
